```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

DATASET_PATH = 'chunks_csv/bivariate/bivariate_2022_gas_energy.csv'
ADJACENCY_PATH = 'chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv'

df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)
adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

boroughs = df['borough'].unique()
n = len(boroughs)
idx_map = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(boroughs)}
W = np.zeros((n, n), dtype=float)
adj_filtered = adj[adj['borough'].isin(boroughs) & adj['neighbor'].isin(boroughs)]
for _, row in adj_filtered.iterrows():
    i = idx_map[row['borough']]
    j = idx_map[row['neighbor']]
    if i != j:
        W[i, j] = 1.0
W = np.maximum(W, W.T)
np.fill_diagonal(W, 0)

# Order df to match boroughs list
df = df.set_index('borough').loc[boroughs].reset_index()
x = df['Gas_value'].values
y = df['Energy_value'].values

zx = x - x.mean()
zy = y - y.mean()

S0 = W.sum()
c = W.T @ zx  # fixed spatial lag of zx
numerator = np.dot(c, zy)
denominator = np.sqrt(np.dot(zx, zx) * np.dot(zy, zy))
L_obs = (n / S0) * numerator / denominator

print('Observed Lee\'s L:', L_obs)
print('Numerator:', numerator)
print('Denominator:', denominator)

# Permutation test
n_perm = 1000
np.random.seed(42)
L_perms = np.empty(n_perm)
for p in range(n_perm):
    zy_perm = np.random.permutation(zy)
    num_perm = np.dot(c, zy_perm)
    L_perms[p] = (n / S0) * num_perm / denominator

# Two-tailed p-value
p_value = (np.sum(np.abs(L_perms) >= np.abs(L_obs)) + 1) / (n_perm + 1)
print('Permutation mean L:', np.mean(L_perms))
print('Permutation std L:', np.std(L_perms))
print('Min perm L:', np.min(L_perms))
print('Max perm L:', np.max(L_perms))
print('p-value (two-tailed):', p_value)
```
